title: QBR lightning readout + contingency-linked roadmap playbook
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Build a concise, decision-focused QBR lightning deck and an accompanying playbook that ties roadmap commitments to contingencies driven by operational signals (latency regressions, cost-per-token spikes, and canary failure rates). The goal is a 20-minute exec readout that ends with explicit go/no-go decision gates and mapped next-actions for roadmap adjustments if risk triggers fire.
acceptance_criteria: 10-slide lightning deck drafted and reviewed by PM + Eng leads
Contingency playbook with 3 operational triggers (latency P95 > target, cost/unit delta > 15%, canary error > 3%) documented with clear actions
Two dry-run rehearsals complete with runbook timings and fallback scripts
Stakeholder sign-off from CTO office and Head of Platform
Readout slide deck exported to PDF and uploaded to Drive, and Confluence playbook linked
decision_points: Approve full rollout of model-quantization initiative or delay pending perf regression mitigations
Move high-cost feature from dedicated to hosted with temporary throttles
Escalate to executive steering for investments > $250k incremental monthly spend

risks: Key metric thresholds not validated across all regions (APAC baseline missing)
Exec readout may drive a binary decision that requires infra spend not approved in current budget cycle
Confusion in stakeholders between feature-level rollback vs model variant fallback
mitigations: Add APAC traffic baselines and a separate appendix tab for regional thresholds
Include a contingency budget ask with explicit spend cap and rollback lane in the deck
Reword playbook actions to use 'model-variant fallback' language and include play examples
rollout_plan: Week -2: Draft deck + playbook; PM/Eng/Design review
Week -1: Two dry runs with invited stakeholders; incorporate feedback
Readout week: 20-minute lightning presentation + 15-minute Q&A; capture decisions and immediate actions
Post-readout: Execute approved contingency steps within 48 hours; update roadmap and communicate to customers if changes affect SLAs
stakeholders: Product Leads - Aisha Raman, Luca Morales
format: Lightning deck (10 slides) + live Q&A + decision matrix appendix
notes: Prefer concise metrics on the main slides; drive technical detail into appendix to keep exec focus on decisions
Coordinate with legal if any contingency action touches customer contracts or SLAs
After-action note: publish a 1-page change log to Confluence summarizing final decisions and timeline
